title: TabProjectionV1
description: Guitar tablature derived from one canonical revision plus the spatial evidence already selected for it. TAB is not a spatial authority: it reports the realization it was given, or says it has none. That is why status is a closed three-value vocabulary and why string_id and fret are nullable -- an event without selected evidence must be representable as unresolved, since the alternative is a plausible fret nobody chose.

canonical_event_id.description: Always present. A TAB event is a view of a canonical event, never an event of its own, so this is the identity the fretboard and notation views join on.

status.description: playable: selected spatial evidence exists and is reported. unplayable: the instrument cannot produce this pitch, an explicit outcome the spatial layer already reached. unresolved: canonical music exists but no realization was selected for it.

allOf.description: A playable event must carry the realization that made it playable; anything else would be a status with no evidence behind it.
An event with no selected realization must not carry one. This is the schema-level half of the rule that TAB never invents a fingering.
